lines.1: 「I am grateful that you helped me give up my sleeping pills.」
lines.7: 「At this rate, you'll gradually become unable to live without me.」
lines.8: 「More foolishness... I will refuse to date you.」
lines.9: Neither of us steps further into the other's life than necessary.
lines.10: I am myself. You are yourself. A firmly established distance.
lines.12: But perhaps this will let us spend our lives together longer than clinging to each other constantly.
lines.15: 「I told a friend from university about the rhythm of our relationship, and she laughed.」
lines.16: 「She said it had neither dreams nor romance.」
lines.18: 「...But I find things perfectly satisfactory as they are.」
lines.20: 「It does not matter what anyone else says.」
lines.21: 「This is our way of doing things.」
lines.24: Our time together flows onward at an easy pace...
